theories.claim: QA investigator shard execution accepts a runtime that reports unrestricted permissions or non-default-deny policy and still produces retained theories.
theories.basis: qa_prompt.go sets Sandbox=read_only Permissions=restricted and Policy.Default=deny with explicit allow for read/list/search/glob and deny for write/edit/patch/bash/shell; qa.go runOneQAShard validates result.Permissions.Mode==restricted, Default==deny, UnsupportedCount==0 and returns QAError permission_denied otherwise before decoding output.
theories.confirmation_condition: runOneQAShard with pruntime.Result Permissions Mode=unrestricted or Default!=deny returns no error and persists theories with Phase=completed.
theories.refutation_condition: runOneQAShard with permissive Permissions returns QAError Category=permission_denied and shard does not reach completed with theories.
theories.inconclusive_condition: No runtime configured or target identity unavailable prevents reaching permission check.
theories.safe_evidence_strategy: Read QAInvestigatorRequest permission construction and runOneQAShard guard; inspect qa_test.go:187-196 permission fallback test; if bounded execution allowed, run deterministic unit test with fake runtime returning unrestricted permissions and observe returned error category without filesystem mutation.

theories.claim: Implementation identity (targetIdentity) drift during QA investigation or approved go-format-diff check is not detected, allowing theories to be recorded against a mutated filesystem.
theories.basis: runOneQAShard captures before and after targetIdentity and aborts with permission_denied if after != before or afterErr; RunApprovedQACheck captures before/after and aborts similarly; targetIdentity in verify.go hashes all contained files via WalkDir, rejects escaping symlinks, and includes git head when repo root equals target.
theories.confirmation_condition: Mutating target (e.g., writing drift.txt) between before and after captures still yields shard Phase=completed with retained theories or check summary without error.
theories.refutation_condition: Mutation causes runOneQAShard or RunApprovedQACheck to return QAError Category=permission_denied implementation identity changed and shard is not marked completed.
theories.inconclusive_condition: Target is non-existent or git symlinks cause identity to error before comparison; wall-clock or filesystem not observable in read-only static review.
theories.safe_evidence_strategy: Read before/after targetIdentity calls and error handling; inspect qa_prompt_test.go TargetIdentityRejectsSymlinkEscapeAndRecordsContainedSymlink and qa_test.go drift tests; if execution permitted, run approved check with a process runner that writes drift.txt and observe returned category without retaining mutated bytes.

theories.claim: Unknown or unclassified changed file extensions are silently dropped from the QA map without creating a blocked primary shard or coverage entry.
theories.basis: qa_map.go groups by qaBehaviorGroup; unknown extensions return not known and are wrapped as unknown/<path> with Phase=blocked and Coverage.BlockedPaths. ValidateQAMap asserts exactly-one primary ownership. Omission would violate ownership invariant and contradict qa_map_test.go unknown-path expectation.
theories.confirmation_condition: BuildQAMap with input ChangedPaths=[assets/binary.weird] returns 0 shards or ValidateQAMap passes while Coverage.BlockedPaths omits the path.
theories.refutation_condition: BuildQAMap with assets/binary.weird returns one primary shard with Phase=blocked, Blocker.Category=invalid_state, Blocker.Summary=unclassified changed path, and Coverage.BlockedPaths contains assets/binary.weird.
theories.inconclusive_condition: Governance inputs unavailable (PrepareReview findings) or QAMap construction fails before classification with stale_input.
theories.safe_evidence_strategy: Read qa_map.go grouping and blocked-shard branch without writing state; re-derive BuildQAMap deterministically with fixture input containing assets/binary.weird; inspect returned QAMap.Shards and Coverage.BlockedPaths via read-only NormalizedQAMapBytes; do not invoke shell, runtime, or Git mutation.

theories.claim: Persisted QA map file can be silently overwritten with different bytes via a second Publish that reuses the same semantic attempt ID, violating immutability.
theories.basis: QAStore.Publish for map uses writeRecord with immutable=true which reads existing bytes and compares via bytes.Equal before atomic write; writeRecord returns QAError conflict if bytes differ; TestQAAtomicFailurePreservesPriorStateAndMapIsImmutable asserts second Publish with altered title fails.
theories.confirmation_condition: Second Publish with same attempt ID but different map bytes succeeds and LoadMap returns second bytes or State digest changes silently.
theories.refutation_condition: Second Publish with differing map bytes returns QAError Category=conflict immutable already exists and prior LoadMap bytes remain unchanged.
theories.inconclusive_condition: Verification directory unavailable or writer fence rejects token before reaching immutable check.
theories.safe_evidence_strategy: Read writeRecord immutable branch and Publish map handling; inspect qa_state_test.go immutable map replacement case; perform read-only Lstat and byte compare of existing map.json if present; do not invoke shell or mutate Git.
